title: Structure-technique-redstone
description: A mod for learning and viewing redstone systems like a portal, furnace, iron factory, etc.
body:
### **Structure Technique Redstone**

Structure Technique Redstone is a mod designed to bring ready-to-use technical and redstone structures directly into your Minecraft worlds. Instead of spending hours designing the basics, you can instantly generate functional builds that make survival and technical gameplay smoother, faster, and more creative.

**🔧 Why download this mod?**

Save time: No need to manually build every redstone contraption from scratch.
Learn and get inspired: Each structure demonstrates useful mechanics that can help beginners understand redstone while giving advanced players new building ideas.
Improve your world: 

Add functional and aesthetic builds without disrupting the balance of survival gameplay.
Perfect for servers or singleplayer: 

Quickly set up useful infrastructure for adventure maps, community worlds, or personal projects.

**🏗️ Structures included**

Stable – A functional place to keep and organize your horses.

Nether Factory – A specialized structure designed for the Nether.

Archery Range – Practice your accuracy with a complete redstone-powered shooting stand.

Automatic Furnace – Cook items efficiently without constant manual input.

Smoke Generator – Add atmosphere and effects to your builds.

Redstone Door – A simple but reliable redstone mechanism for secure bases.

Extra Redstone Tricks – Small technical structures that provide clever and useful functionalities.

Whether you are a technical Minecraft player who wants efficient redstone builds, a builder who enjoys integrating working mechanics, or a server owner who needs quick infrastructure setups, this mod provides practical solutions that fit perfectly into your gameplay.
